kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.dialog.quest_te: Auntie Hong's son left with the salt caravan three months ago and his letters stopped coming. The caravan was last seen on the road to Stone Hamlet.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.dialog.teks: Ah, a new face! Sit down, the tea is still warm. The attic room is free, but if it's news you want, just ask me. Nobody passes this door without my knowing.

kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.misi.naga_muda: The Young Dragon of Jade Lake
A young dragon has woken at the bottom of Jade Lake and the water boils every night. The guild seeks a cultivator able to calm it without killing it.

kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.misi.sarang.cer: A pack of silverfang wolves has denned in the chalk hills and begun to raid livestock. Drive off the pack mother; the cubs will leave on their own.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.misi.surat.ceri: A scribe needs a courier to take a letter to the headman of Stone Hamlet. The road is safe, as long as you don't stop at the wine shop.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.panjang.p3: I only want to copy an old map.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.panjang.p5: Why do the lanterns keep growing in number?
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.panjang.teks: Sit down, young one, and do not touch the third shelf from the left; its ink has not dried since the last dynasty. You ask about the Gate of a Thousand Lanterns? Long ago, before this city's walls stood, seven sects met in this valley to share the spirit river. They swore an oath beneath a single lantern, and each lit a lantern of its own on the way home, and every year there were more. Nobody remembers the oath now, yet the lanterns are still lit every festival. This archive keeps a copy of that oath, half burnt. If you wish to read it there is a price, and the price is not spirit stones.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.pasar.rubah_cer: Found in a burnt den; it fears smoke but loves berries.
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.tagihan.dari: From the people of Stone Hamlet
kultivator.tempat_ui.uji.tagihan.kalimat: Young master, your fight last night brought down the granary wall and broke the hall's windows. We ask no more than the cost of materials and the builders' wage.
The granary is being rebuilt. If you are willing, a gift of materials or labour would be most welcome.
M-master… we would not dare to bill you. It is only that… that granary is the only one we have.
